prerequisite_audit.note: Q1 NumPy oracle is validated by driver and agy; the opus5 audit could not run without a login and is not represented as a pass.

fable_audit.summary: Q2.0 Q1-closure and read-only numeric preflight are approved. Q2.1–Q2.4 implementation remains blocked until Q1 is immutably baselined and all numeric feasibility conditions are satisfied.

final_project_goal: Use CF4 constraints to obtain a statistically valid z=0 local-universe density/velocity posterior, construct an exact q-corrected IC with conditional high-k structure, and forward-validate a zoom IC at an effective observational resolution of <=0.3 cMpc/h.
purpose: Promote the validated Q1 observation operator to a differentiable static-shape JAX implementation and establish value, gradient, and computational-envelope gates before any likelihood expansion.

final_goal_alignment.necessity: A differentiable operator that agrees with the Q1 oracle is required before sampling a CF4 z=0 posterior; otherwise optimization or HMC/SMC gradients can change the inferred field independently of the validated observation model.
final_goal_alignment.sufficiency: Q2 is necessary but not sufficient. It does not calibrate selection/LF/bias/HOD/model discrepancy, establish posterior coverage, add conditional high-k, construct ICs, run PM/HOP, or demonstrate <=0.3 cMpc/h information.

tests: Dedicated sigma>L (recommended sigma=2L) multi-wrap fixture with adaptive-reference agreement and a wrapped-Gaussian/Fourier limit check; do not assume unconditional 3-D uniformity for a one-dimensional LOS displacement.
Adaptive-reference checks for all six populations and at least three sources per boundary/non-boundary fixture, including the widest-sigma population.
Pre-renormalization mass defect and dropped-sliver probability are recorded and gated; post-renormalization mass is labelled by-construction only.
Clip=1e-13 and sliver-merge epsilon=1e-10 are frozen constants with bound tests, or replaced by an explicitly mass-relative rule.

Tail-cutoff 6/8/10 convergence is compared with the frozen 1e-8 tail tolerance; the sigma>L limit is interpreted through a wrapped-Gaussian/Fourier reference, not an unconditional 3-D uniform-field assertion.
Result records contain no unsupported multi-wrap claim.

preflight_freeze_before_implementation.purpose: Measure the actual computational problem instead of confusing secure crossmatch objects with PM source particles.
preflight_freeze_before_implementation.known_non_equivalence: secure_cf4_objects=16584 is not a bound on PM source-particle count; an N=192 particle mesh contains 7077888 cells/particles before zoom refinements.
preflight_freeze_before_implementation.displacement_definition: d_axis_max is the one-sigma stochastic displacement component in cMpc/h: h*sigma_total/(a*H(a))*abs(rhat_axis), with h the little-h conversion, not a velocity or a cell count.
preflight_freeze_before_implementation.segment_bound: K_max = 1 + sum_axis(ceil(2*T*abs(d_axis_max)/cell_spacing) + 2) = 19 for the frozen development bounds, T=8; runtime crossing_count must be <= K_max or fail closed.

frozen_error_formulas.meaning: Absolute L1 is reported raw and the pass criterion uses the actual oracle/reference norm. The denominator floor is used only for reporting relative values, never to loosen the absolute gate.

frozen_resource_ceiling.benchmark_required_dimensions: Use M_pm_source_particles_max=7077888, mesh N=32, six populations, K_max=19, and the frozen development physical bounds; no substitution of M=16584.

static_shape_design.requirement: The JAX graph must have static array shapes under jit; dynamic Python lists, dynamic scatter sizes, and data-dependent shape changes are forbidden.
static_shape_design.candidate: Represent each particle's ordered epsilon intervals in a fixed padded array. Generate a fixed upper bound from the declared maximum displacement component and mesh spacing, mask unused intervals, and fail closed if any input exceeds the bound.
static_shape_design.segment_bound_formula: K_max = 1 + sum_axis(ceil(2*T*abs(d_axis_max)/cell_spacing) + 2), with T=8 and an explicit declared d_axis_max; no silent truncation.
static_shape_design.periodic_rule: All positions are wrapped modulo L before the Q1 cell response; the static implementation must match the torus oracle, not an open-boundary surrogate.
static_shape_design.fallback_rule: The NumPy Q1 oracle remains the reference. A JAX fallback or tail approximation is admissible only if its frozen error gates are met and its shape/overflow limits are explicit.

work_packages.task: First close the Q1 numerical-evidence requirements, then run a read-only local preflight to measure PM source-particle count, mesh/box dimensions, physical sigma bounds, displacement components, K_max, chunk size, padded-array bytes, and resource-budget dimensions. Freeze these numeric values and obtain the Q1 baseline commit before coding.
work_packages.acceptance: Every Q1 closure test passes; every required preflight field is numeric, units are explicit, the Q1 commit/SHA manifest is immutable, and computed K_max/chunk/memory fit the frozen ceilings or Q2 is NO-GO.

work_packages.task: Implement the static-shape JAX value operator as a separate development entrypoint, preserving the Q1 operator and fail-closed input/ownership checks.
work_packages.acceptance: Q2.0 is complete; jax_enable_x64 is required; no production likelihood path is changed; out-of-bound segment counts are rejected rather than truncated.

work_packages.task: Compare JAX values with the Q1 NumPy oracle on both frozen boundary and non-boundary fixtures, including per-population and exposure-weighted diagnostics.
work_packages.acceptance: The frozen scaled-L1 formulas pass for total and every population on both fixtures; raw absolute and relative values are recorded with exact fixture IDs.

work_packages.task: Validate reverse-mode AD against double-precision finite differences or analytic oracle derivatives for positions, velocities, FoG/redshift dispersion, and population masses.
work_packages.acceptance: The frozen central-difference protocol passes scaled gradient gates for all parameter classes and topology cases; NaN/Inf, branch-surface discontinuity, and interval-permutation checks fail closed.

work_packages.task: Benchmark value and gradient evaluation over the exact M_pm_source_particles_max and mesh N frozen by Q2.0, with smaller scaling points for diagnostics.
work_packages.acceptance: Measured dimensions fit every numeric resource ceiling and record peak host/device memory, compile latency, value throughput, gradient throughput, and static segment occupancy. The mathematical operator may not be degraded to meet a runtime target.

release_gates: Q1 NumPy oracle remains unchanged and is independently reproducible.
JAX value agreement passes total and per-population frozen tolerances on both fixtures.
AD gradient agreement and knot/boundary behavior pass all frozen tolerances.
Static-shape overflow, x64, ownership, and finite-support checks are fail-closed.
Performance and memory envelope is documented; no production or posterior call is authorized by Q2 alone.
dependency_blockers: Selection completeness/LF/mean-density and bias/HOD/model-discrepancy calibration remain a separate prerequisite.
64 development-mock calibration and untouched 256-mock coverage/held-out density-velocity frontier remain required before KF-EXPAND.
No observational <=0.3 cMpc/h claim is permitted until response/phase/cross-correlation/variance/coverage gates are complete.

audit_request.focus: Assess whether Q2 is the feasible and final-goal-aligned next bundle after Q1/agy, whether static-shape JAX and gradient requirements are sufficient and realistic, and whether any scope creep or missing blocker exists. Return GO/CONDITIONAL-GO/NO-GO.
